meaning:
§ Gilboa = "swollen heap"
a mountain-ridge at the southeastern end of the plain of Jezreel, site of the death of Saul and Jonathan

elsewhere.note: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.
The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen…
Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
